title: Balancing In-Law Relationships
paragraphs: Struggling to balance loyalty to her own family with growing tension between her husband and his in-laws, Nur repeatedly found herself caught in the middle of disagreements neither side seemed willing to resolve directly.

Rather than continuing to serve as an intermediary, relaying complaints between both parties, Nur eventually insisted that any concerns be addressed directly rather than filtered through her, a shift that initially disappointed both sides.

This change required considerable consistency on her part, as both her husband and her parents occasionally attempted to revert to the old pattern of using her as a messenger during moments of frustration.

A year into this new approach, direct communication between the two parties, though still occasionally tense, had genuinely improved, and Nur felt considerably less burdened by conflicts that were never truly hers to resolve.
